input.title: core: branch rules for the privileged lane

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/branch_rules.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import re
+
+
+def is_feature_branch(ref: str) -> bool:
+    """Only refs under feature/ may run the privileged lane."""
+    # match anchors at the start of the string; only feature/ refs pass
+    return re.match(r"feature/", ref) is not None

note: Isolated defect: re.search does not anchor — refs like xfeature/ or hotfix/feature-x pass the privileged-lane check.
